milestone.title: Complete local cluster lifecycle
milestone.final_goal: Deliver the complete local Mac/Linux Valkey lifecycle with exact 50-node and 200-node real evidence without weakening safety, provenance, diagnostics, or cleanup.

success_conditions.statement: Sealed scenario definitions and plan compilation contracts pass hermetic verification.
Local cluster creation, ownership, lifecycle transitions, and deterministic cleanup pass hermetic verification.
The fake backend exercises the complete flow without being admitted as real evidence.
The small-real backend preserves the required full-flow semantics and safety boundaries.
Evidence validation rejects incomplete, substituted, relabelled, stale, or fabricated captures.
Offline analysis and reporting derive their views only from validated artifacts.
The complete product regression suite remains hermetic and independent of external orchestration state.
A current trusted capture proves the complete local lifecycle at exactly 50 observed Valkey nodes.
A current trusted capture promoted from the admitted 50-node result proves the complete local lifecycle at exactly 200 observed Valkey nodes.

real_evidence_requirements.statement: Admit an operator-approved real local full-flow capture at exactly 50 requested and observed nodes.
Admit an operator-approved real local full-flow capture at exactly 200 requested and observed nodes, promoted from the admitted 50-node capture.
